up: List distinct IC50 activity records in nM for compounds tested against human interleukin-1 receptor-associated kinase 4 (IRAK4). For each qualifying activity, output: compound ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, compound key, and either PubMed ID (preferred) or DOI.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  md.chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  cr.compound_key,
  COALESCE(d.pubmed_id, d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN compound_records cr ON a.record_id = cr.record_id
JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id
WHERE
  td.pref_name = 'interleukin-1 receptor-associated kinase 4'
  AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens'
  AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND a.standard_units = 'nM'
  AND a.standard_relation = '=';
